cards.name: Rubbermaid Brilliance Leak-Proof Food Storage Set (10-piece)
cards.badge: Kitchen storage · the sturdy value set
cards.price: Mid-teens to about $20 on sale at Walmart and Target (2025–26 posts); more at list
cards.buy_if: You want one set that survives a lunchbox, a shaken tote bag and a week of meal prep, and you will hand-wash it or accept the risk.
cards.skip_if: You microwave or dishwasher everything daily for years: buy the glass Brilliance set (Target listed it at $28.49 on Sep 9, 2026) or a dishwasher-proof glass set instead.
cards.owners: Home Depot owners, read Oct 13, 2026: 29 of 68 non-promotional reviews mention cracking; praise is the seal and the clear sides.
cards.video_title: Unboxing  Rubbermaid Brilliance 10 Piece Set and Sample Meal Prep
cards.video_why: It is the only video we found titled for the 10-piece set, so you can see the five sizes side by side.

buy.pick: Rubbermaid Brilliance 10-piece set (model 2183421, Tritan): five containers and five latch lids, in 1.3, 3.2 and 9.6 cups
buy.check: The listing says 10 piece and Tritan, and names model 2183421. '10 pc' counts lids, so it is only five containers. The glass Brilliance set and the 'Pantry' canisters are different products. Prefer a listing sold by the store or Rubbermaid, not a third-party seller with a wide price gap.
